systems.name: Schlage SC1 (6-pin)

systems.notes: 6-pin cylinders with the Classic space/depth chart (e.g. C-series 6-pin). Unverified on a physical 6-pin key — treat code output for the 6th cut with the app's normal uncertainty flags.
